```{r bam2bw,eval=T}
a1<-alias_data$V1
names(a1)<-alias_data$V1
a2<-alias_data$V1
names(a2)<-alias_data$V2
a3<-alias_data$V1
names(a3)<-alias_data$V3
a4<-alias_data$V1
names(a4)<-alias_data$V4
ax<-c(a1,a2,a3,a4)

bam2bw<-function(i,qfilter=0) {
bam_file<-fls[i]
#size<-colData(cds)[match(bam_file %>% gsub("/","\\.",.) %>% gsub("-","\\.",.),colData(cds)$filename %>% gsub("\\.repair","",.)),"sizeFactor"]
param_total <- ScanBamParam(what="mapq",flag = scanBamFlag(isUnmappedQuery = FALSE,isDuplicate = FALSE,isMinusStrand = NA,isMateMinusStrand = NA,isProperPair = FALSE))
size<-countBam(bam_file,param=param_total)$records/1e6
print(size)
bigwig_file<-paste0(strsplit(basename(bam_file) %>% gsub("_trimmed.bam","",.),"\\.")[[1]][1],"_",ts,".bigWig")
temp<-readGAlignments(bam_file,param=param_total)
#seqlevelsStyle(temp.cov)<-"UCSC" # not official UCSC names for galGal6
#a<-alias_data[alias_data$V1 %in% seqlevels(temp),]
#temp_alias<-a$V2
#names(temp_alias)<-a$V1
temp<-renameSeqlevels(temp,ax[names(ax) %in% seqlevels(temp)])
temp.cov<-coverage(temp[mcols(temp)$mapq >= qfilter],weight=1/size)
rtracklayer::export(temp.cov,bigwig_file)
}
```

```{r}
txdb<-TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.ensGene
exons <- exonsBy(txdb, by = "tx",use.names=TRUE)
mcols(exons)$type <- "exon"
mcols(exons)$source <- "TxDb.Celegans.UCSC.ce11.ensGene" 



x<-unlist(exons)
x2<-reduce(x[grep("C12C8.3",(names(x)))])

x2d<-as.data.frame(x2)[,c("seqnames","start","end","strand")]
x2d<-tibble::rownames_to_column(x2d)
colnames(x2d)<-c("GeneID","Chr","Start","End","Strand")

exons_gr<-reduce(unlist(exons))
exons_gr$wls<-paste0(seqnames(exons_gr),":",start(exons_gr),"-",end(exons_gr))
exons_df<-as.data.frame(exons_gr)[,c("wls","seqnames","start","end","strand")]
colnames(exons_df)<-c("GeneID","Chr","Start","End","Strand")
head(exons_df)
dim(exons_df)
```


```{r featureCounts,eval=T}

qfilter<-4



stranded_counts<-featureCounts(fls,
                 annot.ext = x2d,
                 isGTFAnnotationFile=FALSE,
                 strandSpecific=1,
                 nthreads=2,
                 minMQS=0,
                 isPairedEnd=FALSE,
                 checkFragLength=FALSE,
                 requireBothEndsMapped=FALSE,
                 )

all_exons_counts_0<-featureCounts(fls,
                 annot.ext = exons_df,
                 isGTFAnnotationFile=FALSE,
                 strandSpecific=0,
                 nthreads=2,
                 minMQS=0,
                 isPairedEnd=FALSE,
                 checkFragLength=FALSE,
                 requireBothEndsMapped=FALSE,
                 )

save(fls,stranded_counts,all_exons_counts,all_exons_counts_0,file=paste0("aeschimann_lin41_counts_0_q",qfilter,"_",ts,".rdata"))

```
